name: Owatanka
summary: Owatanka is a legendary thunder lizard known among the tauren as Bluebolt, roaming the southern plains of the Barrens. Slaying this swift, electrified beast yields a crackling tailspike that carries its bound lightning to the camp elders. Delivering this trophy to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo honors the tradition of learning from the primordial beasts of Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Beast Called Bluebolt
sections.body: Across the arid expanses of the southern Barrens walks Owatanka, a rare thunder lizard spoken of with reverent respect by tauren hunters. While most of his kin are massive and plodding, Owatanka possesses sudden, blinding speed. The tauren name him Bluebolt, marking him as a creature fundamentally altered by the storm.

sections.title: Fed by the Sky's Rage
sections.body: According to lore kept by Jorn Skyseer, Owatanka was struck directly by lightning long ago. Rather than perishing, the thunder lizard absorbed the celestial strike, fueling an endless wellspring of energetic fury. Even in death, the creature's tailspike crackles violently with stray sparks when handled, a tactile remnant of the storm's power.

sections.title: Trophy of Taurajo
sections.body: Carrying Owatanka's Tailspike back to Camp Taurajo is treated as a rite of prowess and spirit. Jorn Skyseer recognizes the mark of the encounter immediately in the eyes of any hunter who manages to outmatch the beast's speed. In presenting the trophy, the hunter symbolically draws upon Bluebolt's enduring velocity.

aliases: what kind of beast is owatanka
faq.answer: Owatanka is a legendary thunder lizard native to the Barrens. Known to the local tauren as 'Bluebolt', he is renowned for his extraordinary speed and crackling lightning energy.

faq.q: Why does Owatanka spark with lightning?
faq.answer: Tauren legend holds that Owatanka was struck by lightning in the distant past. Instead of killing him, the strike imbued the creature with endless energy and fury fed directly from the sky.

aliases: where do i turn in owatanka
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer is a tauren elder and spiritual guide residing at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He recognizes the latent power of the region's great beasts and accepts trophies like Owatanka's tailspike.
Owatanka roams the arid flatlands of the southern Barrens, typically wandering through the scrub and dirt pathways south of Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver Owatanka's Tailspike?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer commends you for besting the swift thunder lizard, noting that keeping pace with such a creature leaves a lasting spark of energy and power within the hunter.

faq.q: Is Owatanka dangerous compared to normal thunder lizards?
faq.answer: Yes. Beyond the standard toughness of thunder lizards, Owatanka possesses deceptive swiftness and innate electrical power stemming from his legendary lightning strike.

angles.text: Hunting Bluebolt honors ancient tauren traditions of respecting the wild spirits and claiming the vitality of the Barrens' most enduring beasts.
Besting Owatanka is a premier test of stalking and speed, demonstrating that a hunter can outrun and outfight nature's swiftest giants.
The residual lightning bound within Owatanka's tailspike demonstrates how elemental forces of the sky can forever reshape living creatures on Kalimdor.
Culling such an unpredictable, lightning-charged apex predator protects the vulnerable supply trails running near Camp Taurajo.
